thread:
Mira: Quick sync — starting handoff for cumulus-7b (open model). Need a quick sweep: licensing, tokenizer parity, and tail-latency perf. Attaching manifest in repo.

Leo: Ran quick gen tests — seeing mid-token truncation on long prefixes (repro attached). Memory ~12% higher than our baseline. ```python -m tokenize_test --model=cumulus-7b --input "The quick brown fox"```

Sam: I can run a perf sweep tonight. What SLOs should we validate against? p95 < 250ms for 64-token prompt on dedicated? Also which quant profiles were used in canary?

Mira: Canary used q4_0 and q8_0. q4_0 is ~1.3x faster on tokens but fails 4/100 eval queries with hallucinations; q8_0 is safer but heavier.

Dina: Legal note — model license has an external-deps clause and needs a provenance doc + contributor CLA for the repo. @Mira please paste the model repo link and we'll triage.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled — canary -> cluster-ml-canary @ 02:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

Leo: Adding an operational runbook note: if p95 > 400ms during canary, auto-failover to orion-3b-lite. Sam, can you add A/B rollback rule?

Sam: Yep — I'll open infra/runtime#842 with the canary config and A/B 10/90 split + rollback threshold. ETA tomorrow morning.

Mira: One more: who owns embeddings.shape migration (there's a shape change between tokenizer v1/v2)? @Leo?

Leo: I'll own the embeddings-shape migration. Will sync with infra tomorrow 10:00am PT to schedule conversion window.

Mira: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll post links to the manifest + license in this thread once up. :thumbsup:
